mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_trade_cycle_scope (credential_id,symbol,dirty_version,projected_version,projection_status,updated_at) VALUES (#{credentialId},#{symbol},1,0,'PENDING',NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dirty_version=dirty_version+1, projection_status='PENDING', last_error=NULL, updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT credential_id AS credentialId,symbol FROM quant_trade_cycle_scope WHERE dirty_version>projected_version ORDER BY updated_at,credential_id,symbol LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT dirty_version AS dirtyVersion,projected_version AS projectedVersion FROM quant_trade_cycle_scope WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_trade WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol}

SELECT t.id, t.credential_id AS credentialId, t.symbol, t.exchange_trade_id AS exchangeTradeId, t.exchange_order_id AS exchangeOrderId, UPPER(t.side) AS side, COALESCE(soi.position_side,pre.position_side,NULLIF(o.position_side,'BOTH')) AS positionSide, o.position_side AS exchangePositionSide, COALESCE(soi.fill_role,pre.operation_type,execution.operation_type) AS fillRole, COALESCE(soi.position_cycle_key,pre.position_cycle_key) AS positionCycleKey, CASE WHEN o.reduce_only='1' THEN 1 WHEN o.reduce_only='0' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS reduceOnly, o.executed_quantity AS orderExecutedQuantity, t.quantity, t.price, COALESCE(j.commission,t.commission) AS commission, COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(j.commission_asset)),''),NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(t.commission_asset)),'')) AS commissionAsset, COALESCE(j.realized_pnl,t.realized_pnl) AS realizedPnl, t.trade_time AS tradeTime, CASE WHEN COALESCE(execution.source_conflict,0)=1 OR COALESCE(pre.source_conflict,0)=1 OR j.attribution_status='CONFLICT' OR (soi.fill_role IS NOT NULL AND execution.operation_type IS NOT NULL AND soi.fill_role<>execution.operation_type) OR (soi.fill_role IS NOT NULL AND pre.operation_type IS NOT NULL AND soi.fill_role<>pre.operation_type) OR (o.side IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(o.side)<>UPPER(t.side)) OR (soi.exchange_side IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(soi.exchange_side)<>UPPER(t.side)) OR (pre.exchange_side IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(pre.exchange_side)<>UPPER(t.side)) OR (soi.position_side IS NOT NULL AND pre.position_side IS NOT NULL AND soi.position_side<>pre.position_side) OR (soi.position_cycle_key IS NOT NULL AND pre.position_cycle_key IS NOT NULL AND soi.position_cycle_key<>pre.position_cycle_key) OR (o.position_side IN ('LONG','SHORT') AND soi.position_side IS NOT NULL AND o.position_side<>soi.position_side) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sourceConflict, COALESCE(t.strategy_instance_id,soi.strategy_instance_id,pre.strategy_instance_id,o.strategy_instance_id) AS strategyInstanceId FROM quant_trade t LEFT JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id=t.credential_id AND o.symbol=t.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id=t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_order_intent soi ON soi.credential_id=t.credential_id AND soi.symbol=t.symbol AND soi.exchange_order_id=t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id,symbol,client_order_id, MIN(operation_type) AS operation_type, MIN(position_side) AS position_side, MIN(position_cycle_key) AS position_cycle_key, MIN(exchange_side) AS exchange_side, MIN(strategy_instance_id) AS strategy_instance_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type)<>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT position_side)<>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT position_cycle_key)>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT exchange_side)<>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT strategy_instance_id)<>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_strategy_pre_dispatch_intent WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} GROUP BY credential_id,symbol,client_order_id ) pre ON pre.credential_id=t.credential_id AND pre.symbol=t.symbol AND pre.client_order_id=o.client_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id,symbol,exchange_order_id, MIN(operation_type) AS operation_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type)<>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_execution_record WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND operation_type IN ('OPEN','CLOSE') AND exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id,symbol,exchange_order_id ) execution ON execution.credential_id=t.credential_id AND execution.symbol=t.symbol AND execution.exchange_order_id=t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_fill_journal j ON j.credential_id=t.credential_id AND j.symbol=t.symbol AND j.exchange_trade_id=t.exchange_trade_id WHERE t.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND t.symbol=#{symbol} ORDER BY t.trade_time,t.exchange_trade_id,t.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM quant_trade_cycle_fill WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol}
DELETE FROM quant_trade_cycle WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_trade_cycle (id,cycle_key,credential_id,symbol,position_side,status,reconstruction_source, reconciliation_status,reconciliation_reason,opened_at,closed_at, opening_quantity,opening_notional,entry_price,closing_quantity,closing_notional, close_price,remaining_quantity,realized_pnl,commission_display,commission_by_asset, fill_count,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{cycleKey},#{credentialId},#{symbol},#{positionSide},#{status},#{reconstructionSource}, #{reconciliationStatus},#{reconciliationReason},#{openedAt},#{closedAt}, #{openingQuantity},#{openingNotional},#{entryPrice},#{closingQuantity},#{closingNotional}, #{closePrice},#{remainingQuantity},#{realizedPnl},#{commissionDisplay}, CAST(#{commissionByAssetJson} AS JSON),#{fillCount},NOW(3),NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_trade_cycle_scope SET projected_version=#{version}, projection_status='READY', incomplete_count=#{incompleteCount}, inferred_count=#{inferredCount}, last_error=NULL, last_projected_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND dirty_version=#{version}

UPDATE quant_trade_cycle_scope SET projection_status='FAILED', last_error=LEFT(#{reason},1000), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND dirty_version>projected_version
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(c.credential_id AS CHAR) AS credentialId, q.account_name AS accountName, c.symbol, c.position_side AS direction, c.status, c.reconstruction_source AS reconstructionSource, c.reconciliation_status AS reconciliationStatus, c.reconciliation_reason AS reconciliationReason, c.opening_quantity AS openingQuantity, c.opening_notional AS openingNotional, c.entry_price AS entryPrice, c.opened_at AS openedAt, c.closing_quantity AS closingQuantity, c.closing_notional AS closingNotional, c.close_price AS closePrice, c.remaining_quantity AS remainingQuantity, c.realized_pnl AS realizedPnl, c.commission_display AS commission, c.closed_at AS closedAt, c.fill_count AS fillCount FROM quant_trade_cycle c INNER JOIN quant_credential q ON q.id=c.credential_id WHERE c.credential_id IN #{id} AND c.symbol=#{symbol} AND c.opened_at>=#{from} AND c.opened_at<#{to} ORDER BY c.opened_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
